concepts.title: Sequence
concepts.tagline: A program is a list of steps, read in order.
lines: The robot does exactly what the tiles say — first tile first, one tile at a time.
Change one tile and every step after it happens somewhere else. Order matters.
When you step through a run, watch the lit tile: that is the step the robot is doing right now.

concepts.title: Loop
concepts.tagline: Repeating steps can fold into one REPEAT token.
lines: A REPEAT token holds a list of tiles inside it and does the whole list, round after round.
REPEAT x 3 with two Forward tiles inside makes 6 moves — from 2 tiles.
The round badge (2 of 3) tells you which lap the robot is on. Loops are how short programs do long jobs.
